Questions people ask

How much does a website cost in the UK?

With us a small business website costs £225 (Basic), £520 (Standard, with motion graphics) or £1,099 (Premium, with advanced scroll animations). After that, monthly plans are £49 (Care), £69 (Build Fellow) or £159 (Care Plus).

What is a pay monthly website?

You pay once to get your website built (from £225), then a low monthly plan from £49 for hosting, security, updates and changes. You always know what you pay.

Can I see my website before I pay?

Yes. Pick your industry above and open all 3 live sample websites. We then customise the one you like.

How many changes do I get?

Basic includes 2 rounds of changes, Standard 3 rounds, and Premium 3 rounds plus 1 month of website management free.

Do you work outside Burnley?

Yes. We are based in Burnley, Lancashire and build websites for businesses across the UK.
